title: Gartina
imageAlt: Gartina, a friendly dark-haired halfling chef and gardener, carrying food against a painted autumn landscape
imageCaption: Gartina — chef, gardener, protector, and adventurer.
dek: A halfling chef and adventurer who prepares food, studies Gael’s damaged soil and helps restore life while asking whom she should consult and what she still needs to learn.

facts.Defining question: What work does responsible care require?
facts.Artwork: Portrait; Ececilia emoji in the artist gallery

body:
Gartina often enters history carrying food or drink. Tea, coffee prepared specifically for Olokun, and scones give people something familiar while they consider a crisis together. Her intelligence is practical, observant, and willing to revise itself.

You’ve got to have a code.Gartina

Core proposition: if you care about something, learn it well enough that your care becomes competent.

Gartina’s care involves intervention. Gardening, farming, conservation, protection, governance and divine stewardship all choose what may flourish. She asks caretakers to acknowledge those choices, learn enough to make them responsibly, observe what actually follows and revise their methods when reality proves them wrong.

Cooking, gardening, and her parents

Gartina was a gardener and cook before the better-documented Gael history. She learned through spectacular culinary failure, reading, repeated practice, observation, and trying again. The same loop later governs her ecology and strategy: try → fail → observe → learn → try again.

Her parents followed her work from poor restaurants to increasingly ambitious cuisine. They repeatedly showed up, expressed pride, and wanted her to reach her potential. Both are dead by the Zarathis garden conversation. Their love becomes Gartina’s model of care: attention creates curiosity; curiosity creates knowledge; knowledge makes support competent.

Gael’s dead soil · June 2024

When the expedition reaches Titan’s Watch, ruined statues, a decayed cathedral, and lifeless terrain show what happens when Death defeats a land. Gartina reads the soil as the stakes made physical. Cosmic catastrophe is also an ecological condition, and it will require more than victory in battle to repair.

Defending Nienna’s retreat

After Jiangshi is lost, Nienna carries shame and is blamed by Adelia, Bitoshi, and—by Nienna’s account—Nuru. Gartina rejects the maxim that an ally must never be left behind. Returning would probably have killed Nienna too and left both bodies unrecoverable. Refusing retreat can create another pointless death.

Nienna’s later sacrifice remains a different choice. Gartina defends retreat without arguing for survival at any cost: choosing a necessary sacrifice differs from dying because a heroic slogan makes retreat shameful.

Wrath, liberation and Gartina’s miracle

Wrath’s defeat ends a dominant threat without making Gael safe. During the assault Gartina gathers Elenia’s remains rather than leaving them to the battlefield. In the Sanctum on 21 November 2024, she prepares the body, oils and unguents for Reincarnate.

She warns that success may bring Elenia back changed. Saray, Dale, Scribonia and Draygar gather around the ritual; their hope does not guarantee its result. Gartina asks for the friend whose spirit matters to them, accepting whatever changes the return may require.

The spell record and narrator establish the outcome: Elenia emerges alive and still a satyr. Gartina’s stunned response belongs to the same moment as the others’ relief. Gartina makes the costly attempt for Elenia before knowing whether it will work.

Making life durable

Elenia and Adelia help establish or prove a living foothold; Gartina turns toward contaminated soil, viable plants, remediation, seeds, pollination, ecological succession, and practical expansion. By 24 February 2025, Hope and Stake are visible from the Tower, Shadowangel Forest is new, and Gartina says she helped spring the changed terrain into existence.

Gael is free of Wrath’s taint. What was lost can begin to grow anew.Gartina

Restoring life to Gael requires work after the miracle. Gartina and her companions still have to determine what grows, where seeds come from, how pollination continues, and how restored life spreads. Adelia’s later transformation expands an existing restoration; it does not erase the earlier communal labor.

The choice to remain

Before February 2025, Adelia leaves Gael with a group that includes Elenia. Gartina does not know where they went. The Tower becomes quieter. She wants eventually to catch up, but remains because refugees need care, Shadowangel Forest needs exploration, and too few new arrivals from Prima are replacing those who left.

She stays to work where people still need help after attention has moved elsewhere.

Soup, shelter, and consultation · 24 February 2025

Refugees around the Tower live in huts and shacks with occasional magical shelter. Their ship crashed near Crustacean Cove and may be beyond repair. Gartina worries they may feel forgotten, so she and Dale make chicken noodle soup. The discovery that there are no bowls or utensils leads Dale to spend roughly four hundred gold pieces on bowls and spoons.

Immediate care becomes settlement planning. Dale proposes salvaging the wreck for a longhouse. Gartina considers Draygar’s materials and stone or metal from safer parts of the Plains. Then Dale asks whether anyone has consulted the refugees about leadership or their settlement. Gartina admits survival needs had displaced that conversation.

The correction matters: feeding, sheltering, and planning for people do not grant ownership of their future. Dale goes to ask about using the wreckage. Gartina’s work converts cosmic victory into a place where somebody can safely eat dinner, then asks whether the people being helped still control what that place becomes.

The Zarathis garden debate · 11 August 2025

In a garden physically located in Zarathis, Tulaine describes stewardship through patience, hands, instinct, faith, and magic used only as a last resort. Gartina challenges the vagueness of “balance.” Cultivation is already intervention: farmers favor crops over weeds and aphids, while grove keepers draw other boundaries. Every caretaker chooses.

Her demand is blunt: you’ve got to have a code. Acting without knowledge is dangerous. Caring should create curiosity, and love without nurturing understanding is incomplete. Her method is understand → decide → act → observe.

Tulaine represents another knowledge system: love → attend → perceive → respond. Jiangshi asks what happens at the point of sacrifice and distinguishes being sustained by nature from conscious affection chosen by another person. When Gartina becomes vulnerable about her dead parents, Jiangshi places a hand on her shoulder instead of winning the argument.

No one simply wins. Gartina correctly insists that intervention admit its priorities; Tulaine exposes competent knowledge that may resist explicit theory; Jiangshi practices care as intentional presence.

Attention as care

Gartina notices Adelia drifting, regulates her own emotion through breath and routine, recounts what happened, and asks what can be done. She reads blight through relationships among soil, plants, wolves, deer, and human choices while also asking whether she has overstepped. She watches herself think.

Food, ecology, tactics, and settlement are one philosophy expressed at different scales. Tea gives frightened people time to speak. A bowl turns soup into usable care. A map of enemy tactics preserves costly experience. A question asked of refugees limits the authority of helpers.

Her parents’ attention came before expertise; knowledge grew because love made her life worth understanding. Gartina’s principle is not “know everything before you care,” but “if you care, become curious enough that your care stops being careless.”

Relationships that shape the method

  • Her parents: repeated attention becomes her model of love and growth.
  • Jiangshi: explicit analysis meets intentional, embodied presence.
  • Tulaine: causal explanation meets instinctive and traditional stewardship.
  • Dale: relief becomes infrastructure and consultation.
  • Draegar: the retrospective preserves romance beside war; the full relationship chronology is missing.
  • Olokun: ordinary attention and tactical care later become impossible self-blame after loss.
  • Elenia and Adelia: miraculous possibility must be followed by durable restoration.
  • Nienna: survival is defended as a morally serious choice, not cowardice.
  • Quake: a shared estate is map-confirmed, but the relationship behind its name remains unrecovered.
  • Magnus: distrust is strongly expressed but remains Gartina’s attributed judgment rather than objective proof.

Luminar Spires · experimental explorer

At the Luminar Spires, Gartina turns her established method into field research: question → test → observation → revised plan. She considers weather manipulation and tunneling, designs an aerial pass to test whether the western mist’s apparent effects extend vertically, observes figures moving below it, and uses Arjahn’s radiant experiment to propose a moving cleared zone.

Her flight twenty to thirty feet above the visible mist produces no nightmare, vision, or unusual mental effect in that single test. It does not prove everyone is safe above it. When Elenia’s transformed Daylight pulls the party upward, Gartina becomes a giant eagle and retrieves companions, joining investigation to rescue rather than treating the environment as an abstract puzzle.

Preparation and its limit

Gartina remembers tactics and assumes enemies will adapt. Preparation is a form of love: understand enough that fewer people pay. After exhausted resources and a wrong choice contribute to Olokun’s death, that virtue breaks into self-blame. “I should have seen it” is the shadow cast by competence.

Her best pressure point is not being asked to destroy nature. It is being forced to act before she can understand enough, when waiting is itself consequential. No amount of disciplined care can make another person’s survival fully controllable.

Mechanics as biography

A preserved mechanical history records Gartina moving from a grasslands-and-fields identity toward a protector role and losing access to Hallow. The lost ability becomes part of her biography: what she can do changes with what kind of caretaker she has chosen to become. The exact date and scene remain unresolved.

The danger inside her knowledge

Gartina may undervalue embodied, intuitive or traditional expertise when the person carrying it cannot explain how it works. Her insistence on understanding can make other forms of competent care seem unserious. Thorough preparation can also leave her treating ordinary uncertainty as a personal failure.

Interpretive boundary

The supplied “favorite character” essay offers an interpretive synthesis, not an objective ranking or a declaration that Gartina’s framework is always correct. The Codex preserves Tulaine and Jiangshi as independent thinkers rather than props in Gartina’s argument. It also keeps her central risk visible: a person devoted to competent care may fail to recognize knowledge that cannot explain itself in her preferred language.

Unresolved record

  • Her childhood, restaurant chronology, parents’ names, and the circumstances of their deaths.
  • Her precise contribution to Hope’s first sanctification and the full mechanism that makes the seed-created forest endure. The December 2024 planting and seed scene are recovered.
  • The expanded roll table behind the reported odds of Elenia’s unchanged return; Gartina’s Reincarnate and its outcome are now directly recorded.
  • The origins of Gartina and Quake’s Estate and the chronology of her relationship with Draegar.
  • The identity change that cost Hallow and her role in later Hope crises.
  • The exact circumstances of Olokun’s death and the choices for which she blames herself.
  • Where her explicit-knowledge model has failed—and whether she learned to trust knowledge she could not fully explain.

Contemporary reputation · 10 April 2024

Ada’s early profile remembers Gartina as baker, healer, farmer, adventurer and community-builder. Feeding people and maintaining ordinary life already belonged to that public account of her heroism. Read the chronicler’s evidence boundary.

Feeding Babel’s survivors

When captives emerge from the Babel caverns, Gartina begins feeding them. At the later campfire she produces a full meal for roughly a dozen survivors and asks Quille about the seed and the loss of her elder. She urges the group to keep telling their stories and remembering the names of the absent, offering tea when their voices tire.

During the later coastal reconnaissance she tests wind against the mist, retrieves companions as a giant eagle, and surveys above the fog. Her proposals for tunneling or maintaining a moving radiant barrier remain proposals. The account is posted on 26 September 2026 (UTC); it supplies no exact in-world calendar date.

Baking a place in Pristinia

In the tavern account posted on 16 March 2024 (UTC), Nienna encourages Gartina to ask Herb for kitchen work. Gartina offers baked goods before sunrise; Herb offers ingredients and modest pay if they sell, and she accepts. Later, Herb names his beer Tina’s Tincture after her and her friends’ work drying the fields for planting. These are practical contributions remembered in the town’s daily life.

The first grass and the work that follows

When Nienna brings Gartina and Dale to the ground renewed by Elenia and Adelia, Gartina removes her boots and rolls in the grass through tears. The August 2024 scene gives her practical restoration project an intensely personal reward: nature can live here again.

In the scene recorded on 6 December, she follows that joy with soil amendments, rain, a planted Staff of the Woodlands and a magical seed. Draygar refines limestone, Krone carries it and Scribonia helps transport, spread and water the materials. Gartina names the staff-born tree Stake after Krone’s food joke, then gives the name the meaning of shared sacrifice and commitment.

The seed brings forth the forest later called Shadow Angel Forest. Gartina’s delight coexists with fear that its magic may disappear; she hopes the restored ground and anchor trees will make it endure. The scene establishes her action and the narrated result, but leaves the exact permanence mechanism unsettled. Later visitors’ accounts show the forest continuing as a lived place.

Tools for the fields

Gartina commissions six each of hoes, spades and pitchforks, plus three plow blades, from Jon. She favors durability over speed. Jon estimates forty gold and three weeks, with twenty-five gold for materials and fifteen for labor. The exchange records the commission and corrected materials deposit; it does not record delivery.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

Babel · gathering, defense and a familiar meal

On the June supply journey Gartina leaves her stored materials at the Refuge so they will remain useful if the expedition fails. When a green dragon challenges the company, she transforms into an ancient brass dragon and draws the territorial opponent into an aerial fight. She attacks to protect her friends; after the dragon falls, Saray works to gather from the body.

In July, Gartina asks Arjahn what the shelter needs and offers to look for common metal rather than spend the rarer resources reserved for crafting. Their conversation turns to food, recipes and his memories of cooking for his family. His returning smile belongs beside her spectacular magic: ordinary conversation provides another kind of care. The packet’s proposed transformation and escape at the end of that outing do not separately show a completed retreat.

Scenes in sequence

These selected scenes preserve what was knowable when people acted. Dates below identify source postings in UTC; they do not supply an in-world calendar. A later appearance does not settle present status.

  1. 2024-08-02 · compatible RP

    Living ground is personally consequential

    Gartina weeps at the green ground and removes her boots to feel the grass.

    Known at this stage
    A small living foothold is visible within the devastated landscape.
    Consequence
    Restoration matters to her before it becomes a large regional achievement.
    Still unresolved
    Her response is not evidence of sole authorship.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2

  2. 2024-11-21 · checked scenes

    Risking change for a friend’s return

    Gartina prepares Elenia’s body and casts Reincarnate; Elenia emerges alive and still a satyr.

    Known at this stage
    Gartina explicitly accepts the possibility of change before the outcome.
    Consequence
    Her care is a concrete action in the aftermath of Wrath, shared with the friends gathered around her.
    Still unresolved
    The narrated outcome does not establish divine control over the rolls.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3 · Receipt 4 · Receipt 5 · Receipt 6

  3. 2024-12-06 · compatible RP

    A staff, a tree and material help

    Gartina plants her staff; narration describes its pine transformation. Later she credits Krone’s limestone transport.

    Known at this stage
    The group acts with prepared materials; permanent regional safety is not established.
    Consequence
    Magic and practical labor both belong in the restoration account.
    Still unresolved
    The tree transformation does not by itself prove every forest effect permanent.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3

  4. 2025-02-24 · compatible RP

    Choosing to remain

    Gartina says she wants to rejoin the others eventually but stays because refugees and the new forest need work.

    Known at this stage
    She understands the choice as a tension with her Vanguard commitments.
    Consequence
    Her continuing care is an active decision after the expedition’s spectacular victories.
    Still unresolved
    This statement does not record a resignation or a formal change in command.

    Receipt 1

  5. 2026-06-23–24 · quest

    A dragon form protects the gathering party

    Gartina takes brass-dragon form and engages the green dragon; Saray later gathers from the fallen creature.

    Known at this stage
    The party is outside to obtain supplies for the Refuge.
    Consequence
    Provisioning and direct defense belong to the same work.
    Still unresolved
    The fight does not establish that every wild creature serves the island’s hostile rulers.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3 · Receipt 4 · Receipt 5 · Receipt 6

  6. 2026-07-31 · quest

    Care returns to a familiar subject

    Gartina and Arjahn discuss useful materials, cooking and family meals while moving through the jungle.

    Known at this stage
    Morale at the Refuge concerns him as much as the missing supplies.
    Consequence
    A remembered meal briefly makes room for warmth beside grief.
    Still unresolved
    The later conditional escape statement is not proof of a completed encounter or retreat.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3 · Receipt 4 · Receipt 5 · Receipt 6 · Receipt 7 · Receipt 8

sections.title: Babel · gathering, defense and a familiar meal

evidence.label: Hunting scenes · outcomes and attributed accounts
evidence.summary: Selected hunting scenes and checked outcomes; character explanations retain attribution. Dates locate source postings rather than an in-world calendar.

evidence.label: Checked scenes · bounded conclusions
evidence.summary: Selected original scenes checked. Observed actions, plans and attributed statements remain distinct. This does not certify the entire biography.

brief.significance: A halfling chef and adventurer who prepares food, studies Gael’s damaged soil and helps restore life while asking whom she should consult and what she still needs to learn.
brief.status: Last dated entry in this selection: 26 Sep 2026 · posting date (UTC). Later status is not established here.
brief.basis: Existing public dossier, explicit status facts and named timeline participants. Selected events are a reading guide, not a complete list or a ranking of importance.

relationshipMap.title: Gartina’s relationship web
relationshipMap.intro: Gartina’s relationships show care becoming food, knowledge, shelter, restoration, and preparation. Select a tie to see where competence sustains people—and where it becomes arrogance or impossible self-blame.

nodes.title: Her parents
nodes.subtitle: Attention as a model of love
nodes.history: Gartina’s parents followed her work from poor restaurants toward greater ambition, repeatedly showing up, expressing pride, and wanting her to reach her potential.
nodes.consequence: Their pattern becomes her philosophy: attention creates curiosity; curiosity produces knowledge; knowledge lets support become competent rather than careless.
nodes.evidence: The remembered pattern is established; their names, deaths, and full family history remain unresolved.

nodes.title: Jiangshi
nodes.subtitle: Presence beyond explanation
nodes.history: In the Zarathis garden debate, Jiangshi distinguishes being sustained by nature from being consciously loved by another person. When Gartina becomes vulnerable about her parents, Jiangshi simply places a hand on her shoulder.
nodes.consequence: The gesture gives Gartina a form of care that does not need to win an argument or provide a causal theory before it can be real.
nodes.evidence: The garden exchange is directly preserved; their wider friendship remains partly recovered.

nodes.title: Tulaine
nodes.subtitle: Embodied stewardship challenged
nodes.history: Gartina demands that caretakers name what they favor and why. Tulaine trusts patience, instinct, faith, and hands-on practice that may resist Gartina’s preferred causal language.
nodes.consequence: Neither method simply defeats the other. Gartina exposes hidden choices inside stewardship; Tulaine exposes knowledge that can be competent without explaining itself in Gartina’s terms.
nodes.evidence: The debate is established; neither philosophy is declared objectively complete.

nodes.title: Dale
nodes.subtitle: Relief becomes settlement
nodes.history: Gartina and Dale make soup for Gael’s refugees, acquire bowls and spoons, consider salvaged housing, and move from emergency care toward permanent settlement.
nodes.consequence: Dale asks whether anyone consulted the refugees. Gartina accepts the correction: feeding and planning for people do not grant ownership of their future.
nodes.evidence: The relief and consultation sequence is established; the settlement’s later outcome remains incomplete.

nodes.title: Draygar WarSmash
nodes.subtitle: Love beyond catastrophe
nodes.history: Their relationship grows through consultation, food, domestic life, and Draygar’s willingness to seek Gartina’s judgment. Later language identifies her as his love.
nodes.consequence: The bond keeps both characters from becoming only functions—warrior and caretaker—and places an ordinary shared future beside world-scale danger.
nodes.evidence: The romance and later intimacy are established; its beginning and full chronology remain incomplete.

nodes.title: Olokun
nodes.subtitle: Ordinary attention, impossible guilt
nodes.history: Gartina prepares coffee specifically for Olo, remembers tactical patterns around him, and later carries the belief that she should have foreseen the choices contributing to his death.
nodes.consequence: The relationship exposes the shadow of competence: careful love can become a false promise that nobody important will be lost if she prepares well enough.
nodes.evidence: The pattern and self-blame are established; the complete later death sequence remains unresolved.

nodes.title: Elenia
nodes.subtitle: Miracle and maintenance
nodes.history: Elenia helps create miraculous possibility in Gael; Gartina reads soil, seeds, pollination, shelter, and the work required to make that possibility survive tomorrow.
nodes.consequence: Their histories resist solitary-hero mythology. World-changing intervention and sustained ecological labor are complementary forms of care.
nodes.evidence: The shared restoration context is established; exact individual contributions remain partly unresolved.

nodes.title: Adelia & Hope
nodes.subtitle: Attention before and after departure
nodes.relation: Restoration continues after the miracle leaves
nodes.history: Gartina notices Adelia’s state, shares the early living Gael context, and remains after Adelia departs. Adelia’s later transformation expands a restoration already maintained by many hands.
nodes.consequence: Neither divine transformation nor early practical labor erases the other. Hope survives as accumulated relationship rather than individual authorship.
nodes.evidence: The broad sequence is established; intermediate chronology remains incomplete.

nodes.title: Nienna
nodes.subtitle: Retreat defended as moral choice
nodes.history: After Jiangshi is lost, Gartina rejects the claim that Nienna should have returned to an impossible rescue. Another body would not have restored the first.
nodes.consequence: Nienna’s later self-chosen sacrifice does not rewrite retreat as cowardice. Gartina preserves the distinction between choosing one’s own cost and dying because a slogan forbids survival.
nodes.evidence: Gartina’s defense and Nienna’s later choice are established; some intervening scenes remain incomplete.

nodes.title: Quake
nodes.subtitle: Shared estate, incomplete story
nodes.history: Pristinia’s map names Gartina and Quake’s Estate, giving their association a durable place in the settlement’s geography. Ada also remembers them as farming partners.
nodes.consequence: The location proves shared civic history while refusing to invent the private relationship behind its name.
nodes.evidence: The estate and public association are established; ownership, origin, and personal chronology remain unresolved.

nodes.title: Magnus Niriin
nodes.subtitle: Distrust kept attributed
nodes.relation: A caretaker’s suspicion, not omniscient proof
nodes.history: Gartina regards Magnus’s claim to have changed after Pride’s death as transparently false and views parts of his political rise with suspicion.
nodes.consequence: Her judgment matters because it shapes trust and future preparation. It remains testimony rather than an automatic verdict on every hidden motive.
nodes.evidence: Gartina’s distrust is established; the Codex does not promote it to objective omniscience.

insights.label: Original model
insights.note: Love begins as repeated attention to another person’s growth.

insights.label: Best correction
insights.note: Competent help still has to ask what people want.

insights.label: Greatest vulnerability
insights.note: Preparation breaks into the belief that she should have prevented everything.

insights.label: Open bond
insights.note: The shared place is known; the relationship behind it is not.

profile.personality: Gartina treats preparation as care. Cooking, reconnaissance, codes of conduct, and rescue all belong to the same instinct: understand what people need before the danger reaches them, then accept more responsibility than is always fair to place on one person.
profile.achievements: She helps establish Pristinia, investigates Eovar’s epidemic, crosses toward Gael, survives the tomb mission under Wrath’s pressure, witnesses Moirah’s costly return, and later surveys Babel-Ashur’s western mist in giant-eagle form. Her field work repeatedly turns mobility and attention into other people’s survival. Commissioned durable agricultural tools from Jon; the room records the order and deposit, not delivery.
profile.relationships: Nienna and Elenia form the emotional center of Gartina’s history, with Quake, Jiangshi, Dale, and Scribonia recurring across early expeditions. She defends Nienna’s retreat when others call it cowardice, defending her friend’s decision as well as her physical safety.
